current.text: He is projected to start at center for Milwaukee to open the season.
Milwaukee traded for Kel'el Ware, who competes with him for frontcourt minutes.
Ware may limit his minutes. Without the Ware trade, experts would rank him higher.
Experts blame much of his poor 2025-26 season on former coach Doc Rivers, who benched him at random and in fourth quarters for Jericho Sims. Rivers is gone, and Taylor Jenkins is the new head coach.

Experts disagree on a bounce-back. Some call him a bounce-back candidate who should not be written off. Others question his motivation after a miserable season, or ask whether he is simply washed at 30. One expert expects him to be only a little better than last year.
If he plays 30 minutes with 2.2 blocks and 2.5 threes per game, he is easily a top 70 player.
Experts say he is overpriced at an ADP near 88 and fine around picks 100 to 128. One expert calls him his biggest fade at 88.
In auction mocks, one expert values him at 1 to 3 USD. He went for 6 USD.
Milwaukee's rotation is unclear. The starting lineup could change by December or March, and new coach Jenkins might use a deep rotation.
Experts expect Milwaukee to focus more on developing young players as the season goes on, which could cut veteran minutes later in the season.
Experts expect Milwaukee to be a bad team, with about 33 wins. The Bucks do not own their draft pick.

durable.text: His fantasy value comes from blocks and threes. His blocks are far above the league pool, and he makes many threes for a center.
He is a weak rebounder for a center and gives almost no assists.
His FG% is weak for a center.
He needs good point guard play in the pick and roll. When he is not used properly, he is mostly parked in the corner.
He is worth less in points leagues than in category leagues.

note: Turner is a cheap source of blocks and threes from the center spot. Yahoo values him at 1 USD (average cost 1.2 USD) and ESPN at 3 USD, while our league paid 20 USD last season before he shot 44.0% from the field. He fits punt FG% builds that need blocks and threes from a big, and experts call him fine around picks 100 to 120 or a few USD in an auction, but not as a top 90 pick. Early in the season, check whether he gets close to 30 minutes next to Kel'el Ware under Taylor Jenkins and whether his FG% recovers from 44%.
